object.attr: as implemented: the resolver takes the one common ancestor that git's library picks, not a virtual base (checked in the code on 2026-11-11, review Q31). In a criss-cross history a change on both sides can then read as one-sided (CF-V51). Replaced by MELLON-VER-SRS-311.
object.description: When ours and theirs have more than one merge base, Mellon shall merge from the one that `git merge-base` reports.
